executive_decision_model.title: Executive decision brief and release-authorization record model
executive_decision_model.statement: The shape of the executive release-decision brief and release-authorization record that a future, separately authorized release decision would populate, defining the decision without taking it.
executive_decision_model.prohibited_inference: A decision brief is not a decision, and a release-authorization record model is not a granted release authorization.

executive_decision_evidence_requirements.title: Executive decision evidence requirement
executive_decision_evidence_requirements.statement: The requirement that any executive release decision be supported by the full decision brief, accepted dossiers, outstanding blockers, residual-risk statement, and explicit statement of what the decision does not authorize.
executive_decision_evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: A decision brief is not a decision.
